category_title: Students who commit property damage but demonstrate accountability
scenario_title: Youth Court hearing for property damage
minimal_context: Felix is participating in a Youth Court hearing to negotiate a sentence for a broken metal window grate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are here at the Youth Court hearing to discuss the broken metal window grate.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I broke it when wrestling around with another student.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to assign you to an after-school consequence program for the damage.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am in drug and alcohol classes after school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you propose we do about the damage then?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: After I realized the gate was broken I took it down and was trying to fix it. I am in construction. I can fix it.
